title: Half-Full Paint Canonical Representation
description: A width x height grid divided into rooms by thick walls. White, gray and black circle clues sit on grid lines (edge midpoints or interior corners), in doubled coordinates where cell (r, c) has its centre at (2r+1, 2c+1). The solver shades cells: every room is all shaded, all unshaded or half shaded with each colour connected, and each circle shows the majority of the cells it touches.

h.description: (height-1) x width: h[r][c] = 1 for a wall between (r, c) and (r+1, c).

v.description: height x (width-1): v[r][c] = 1 for a wall between (r, c) and (r, c+1).

dc.description: Doubled column coordinate, 1..2*width-1; at least one of dr, dc is even.
